note: The ONLY place a T-LDM threshold is defined. scripts/test_all.py fails if a config or the trainer disagrees. Values are the ones already in force (nothing was raised or lowered): the acceptance gate is what the held-out results are judged against; the publish floor only blocks the all-UNK / pwd failure (a head at or below it is never published).
decision_rule: a count k of n held-out tasks passes only if the lower end of its 95% Wilson interval is >= acceptance_heldout; fails only if the upper end is below it; otherwise it is INCONCLUSIVE (see gate/stats.py)
